items.source: The time-to-live (TTL) is computed on each write operation. Redis uses millisecond granularity for timeouts. Any more granular values (e.g. micros or nanos) are not considered and will be truncated due to rounding. Returning Duration.ZERO, or a value less than Duration.ofMillis(1), results in a persistent value that does not expire.
items.translation: time-to-live (TTL) 会在每次写入操作时进行计算。Redis 使用毫秒粒度来处理超时时间。任何更精细的值（例如微秒或纳秒）将不被考虑，并会因四舍五入而被截断。返回 Duration.ZERO 或小于 Duration.ofMillis(1) 的值，将导致返回一个不会过期的持久化值。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
items.translation: 指示某些其他对象是否“等于”此对象。如果另一个对象属于同一类且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。本记录类中的所有组件均使用 Objects::equals(Object,Object) 进行比较。
